import * as THREE from './three.module.js';
import {CameraObservation} from './camera-observation.js';
import {sanitizeCameraSettings} from './camera-settings.js';
const clamp=(x,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x)),smooth=(a,b,x)=>{const t=clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t);};
export class CameraSpring{
 constructor(f=3.2,limit=.03){this.w=2*Math.PI*f;this.limit=limit;this.x=0;this.v=0;}
 reset(x=0){this.x=x;this.v=0;}
 step(target,h){const w=this.w,d=this.x-target,c=this.v+w*d,e=Math.exp(-w*h);this.x=target+(d+c*h)*e;this.v=(this.v-w*c*h)*e;if(!Number.isFinite(this.x)||!Number.isFinite(this.v)){this.reset();return;}if(Math.abs(this.x)>this.limit){this.x=clamp(this.x,-this.limit,this.limit);if(this.v*this.x>0)this.v=0;}}
 visual(){return this.limit*.5*Math.tanh(this.x/(this.limit*.5));}
}
// Sole owner of final camera transform and FOV. Never writes vehicle/input/road.
export class CameraRig{
 constructor(camera,eye,settings){this.camera=camera;this.eye=eye.clone();this.settings=sanitizeCameraSettings(settings);this.observation=new CameraObservation(eye);this.side=new CameraSpring(3.2,.04);this.vertical=new CameraSpring(3.7,.024);this.longitudinal=new CameraSpring(3.2,.06);this.pitch=new CameraSpring(3.5,.04);this.longPitch=new CameraSpring(2.6,.12);this.roll=new CameraSpring(3.5,.04);this.gaze=new CameraSpring(2.8,.4);for(const k of ['position','targetPosition','forward','up','slowUp','slowForward','offset','target','chasePosition','previousPosition','velocityForward','transitionOffset','transitionPosition'])this[k]=new THREE.Vector3();this.targetQ=new THREE.Quaternion();this.rotationQ=new THREE.Quaternion();this.transitionQ=new THREE.Quaternion();this.transitionWorldQ=new THREE.Quaternion();this.lookMatrix=new THREE.Matrix4();this.mode=this.settings.mode;this.previousMode=this.mode;this.blend=1;this.effect=0;this.stabilization=0;this.safety=0;this.driftActive=false;this.driftClock=0;this.driftWeight=0;this.orbitYaw=0;this.orbitPitch=0;this.orbitActive=false;this.releaseAge=10;this.fov=this.settings.fov;this.gazeTarget=0;this.reason='reset';this.needsReset=true;this.faults=0;this.steps=0;this.cpuBuffer=new Float32Array(1800);this.frameBuffer=new Float32Array(1800);this.metricCount=0;this.metricIndex=0;}
 setSettings(s){this.settings=sanitizeCameraSettings(s);this.setMode(this.settings.mode);}
 setMode(mode){if(mode===this.mode)return;this.rotationQ.copy(this.observation.q).conjugate();this.transitionOffset.copy(this.camera.position).sub(this.observation.previousOrigin).applyQuaternion(this.rotationQ);this.transitionQ.copy(this.rotationQ).multiply(this.camera.quaternion);this.previousMode=this.mode;this.mode=mode;this.blend=0;this.orbitActive=false;this.orbitYaw=this.orbitPitch=0;this.releaseAge=10;this.resetDynamics();}
 resetDynamics(){for(const s of [this.side,this.vertical,this.longitudinal,this.pitch,this.longPitch,this.roll,this.gaze])s.reset();this.inertiaGain=0;this.longPitchTarget=0;this.effect=0;this.stabilization=0;this.driftActive=false;this.driftClock=this.driftWeight=0;}
 reset(v){this.observation.reset(v);this.resetDynamics();this.safety=0;this.slowUp.fromArray(v.basis.up);this.slowForward.fromArray(v.basis.forward);this.orbitActive=false;this.orbitYaw=this.orbitPitch=0;this.releaseAge=10;this.blend=1;this.needsReset=true;this.reason='reset';}
 resume(v){this.observation.reset(v);for(const spring of [this.side,this.vertical,this.longitudinal,this.pitch,this.longPitch,this.roll,this.gaze])spring.v=0;this.driftActive=false;this.driftClock=0;this.reason='resume-warmup';}
 rebase(shift){this.observation.rebase(shift);for(const k of ['position','targetPosition','target','chasePosition','previousPosition','transitionPosition'])this[k].z-=shift;this.camera.position.z-=shift;}
 beginOrbit(){this.orbitActive=true;this.releaseAge=0;}
 moveOrbit(dx,dy){if(!this.orbitActive)return;this.orbitYaw=clamp(this.orbitYaw-dx,-Math.PI,Math.PI);this.orbitPitch=clamp(this.orbitPitch+dy,-.16,.6);}
 releaseOrbit(){this.orbitActive=false;this.releaseAge=0;}
 step(v,h,road){const o=this.observation,s=this.settings;o.step(v,h);this.steps++;const safe=o.safe?1:0;this.safety+=(safe-this.safety)*(1-Math.exp(-h/(safe?.25:.06)));this.reason=!o.valid?'warmup':safe?'active':'limited';const active=this.mode===1&&s.firstPerson==='driver';this.effect+=((active?1:0)-this.effect)*(1-Math.exp(-h/.18));this.stabilization+=((s.horizon?.55*this.effect:0)-this.stabilization)*(1-Math.exp(-h/.18));this.slowUp.lerp(o.u,1-Math.exp(-h/.65)).normalize();this.slowForward.lerp(o.f,1-Math.exp(-h/.65)).normalize();
 const a=o.filteredAcceleration,lo=o.slowAcceleration,intensity=s.inertia?s.intensity/100:0,gain=intensity*this.effect*this.safety*(1+.15*smooth(80,200,o.speed*3.6));
 this.inertiaGain=gain;this.longPitchTarget=-clamp(a.z,-12,12)*.0045*gain;this.longPitch.step(this.longPitchTarget,h);
 // Independent acceleration-driven head pitch; existing angular-acceleration response retained.
 this.side.step(-.7*a.x/this.side.w**2*gain,h);this.longitudinal.step(-.7*a.z/this.longitudinal.w**2*gain,h);this.vertical.step(-(.12*lo.y+.22*(a.y-lo.y))/this.vertical.w**2*gain,h);this.pitch.step(-.16*o.localAlpha.x/this.pitch.w**2*gain,h);this.roll.step(-.16*o.localAlpha.z/this.roll.w**2*gain,h);
 const forwardValid=o.valid&&o.forwardSpeed>3&&this.safety>.5,velocityGate=smooth(3,10,o.forwardSpeed),absBeta=Math.abs(o.beta);if(forwardValid&&s.drift&&active){if(!this.driftActive&&absBeta>.12){this.driftClock+=h;if(this.driftClock>.1)this.driftActive=true;}else if(absBeta<.075){this.driftClock+=h;if(this.driftClock>.18)this.driftActive=false;}else this.driftClock=0;}else{this.driftActive=false;this.driftClock=0;}
 const driftTarget=this.driftActive?smooth(.075,.35,absBeta)*.8:0;this.driftWeight+=(driftTarget-this.driftWeight)*(1-Math.exp(-h/.18));let roadYaw=0,roadWeight=0;if(active&&s.autoLook&&forwardValid&&road?.confidence>0){this.offset.set(road.x-v.x,road.y-v.y,road.z-v.z);const U=this.offset.dot(o.f),V=this.offset.dot(o.r);if(U>2){roadYaw=clamp(Math.atan2(V,U),-.28,.28);roadWeight=road.confidence*.75*velocityGate;}}
 const betaTarget=clamp(o.beta,-.38,.38),dw=active&&forwardValid&&s.drift?this.driftWeight*velocityGate:0,anticipation=active&&s.autoLook&&forwardValid?clamp(v.yawRate*.10,-.07,.07)*velocityGate:0;const x=1+roadWeight*Math.cos(roadYaw)+dw*Math.cos(betaTarget),y=roadWeight*Math.sin(roadYaw)+dw*Math.sin(betaTarget);this.gazeTarget=active&&forwardValid?clamp(Math.atan2(y,x)+anticipation,-.38,.38):0;
 const before=this.gaze.x;this.gaze.step(this.gazeTarget,h);const maxRate=.8;this.gaze.x=clamp(this.gaze.x,before-maxRate*h,before+maxRate*h);this.gaze.v=clamp(this.gaze.v,-maxRate,maxRate);
 if(!this.orbitActive){this.releaseAge+=h;if(s.recenter&&this.releaseAge>.9){const e=Math.exp(-h*2.5*s.recenterSpeed);this.orbitYaw*=e;this.orbitPitch*=e;if(Math.abs(this.orbitYaw)<1e-5)this.orbitYaw=0;if(Math.abs(this.orbitPitch)<1e-5)this.orbitPitch=0;}}
 const extra=active?s.dynamicFov*smooth(40,200,o.speed*3.6)*smooth(0,3,o.forwardSpeed):0,targetFov=(this.mode===1?s.fov:59)+extra;const change=(targetFov-this.fov)*(1-Math.exp(-h/(targetFov>this.fov?.6:.8)));this.fov+=clamp(change,-6*h,6*h);
 this.computeTarget(v);if(this.needsReset){this.chasePosition.copy(this.targetPosition);}else if(this.mode===0){const chaseAlpha=1-Math.exp(-h*14);this.chasePosition.lerp(this.targetPosition,chaseAlpha);this.offset.copy(this.chasePosition).sub(this.targetPosition);if(this.offset.lengthSq()>1.44)this.chasePosition.copy(this.targetPosition).add(this.offset.setLength(1.2));}
 }
 computeTarget(v){const s=this.settings,o=this.observation;this.forward.fromArray(v.basis.forward);this.up.fromArray(v.basis.up);this.targetPosition.set(v.x,v.y,v.z);
 if(this.mode===1){this.offset.copy(this.eye);this.offset.x+=this.side.visual();this.offset.y+=this.vertical.visual();this.offset.z+=this.longitudinal.visual();this.offset.applyQuaternion(o.q);this.targetPosition.add(this.offset);
 const hybrid=this.effect*this.safety;const stab=this.stabilization*this.safety;
 // Body yaw retained; only fast pitch/roll deviations are partially filtered.
 this.up.lerp(this.slowUp,stab).normalize();const pitchCorrection=clamp((this.slowForward.y-this.forward.y)*stab,-.10,.10);this.forward.y+=pitchCorrection;this.forward.normalize();
 const yaw=this.gaze.x*hybrid,pitch=-clamp(this.pitch.visual()+this.longPitch.visual(),-.06,.06)*hybrid-.018;this.forward.multiplyScalar(Math.cos(yaw)).addScaledVector(o.r,Math.sin(yaw)).addScaledVector(this.up,pitch).normalize();this.up.addScaledVector(o.r,-this.roll.visual()*hybrid).normalize();}
 else if(this.mode===0){let heading=v.yaw;if(o.valid&&o.forwardSpeed>5&&Math.abs(o.beta)<1)heading+=clamp(o.beta*.10,-.10,.10)*this.safety;const angle=heading+this.orbitYaw,dist=s.chaseDistance,height=s.chaseHeight+this.orbitPitch*dist;this.targetPosition.set(v.x-Math.sin(angle)*dist,v.y+height,v.z-Math.cos(angle)*dist);this.target.set(v.x+Math.sin(v.yaw)*1.7,v.y+.4,v.z+Math.cos(v.yaw)*1.7);this.forward.copy(this.target).sub(this.targetPosition).normalize();this.up.set(0,1,0);}
 else{this.targetPosition.addScaledVector(o.f,.5);this.targetPosition.y=v.y+.96;this.forward.set(Math.sin(v.yaw),(-.24-v.pitch*12)/25,Math.cos(v.yaw)).normalize();this.up.set(0,1,0);}
 if(this.up.dot(this.forward)>.98||this.up.dot(this.forward)<-.98)this.up.copy(o.r);this.up.addScaledVector(this.forward,-this.up.dot(this.forward)).normalize();this.target.copy(this.targetPosition).add(this.forward);this.lookMatrix.lookAt(this.targetPosition,this.target,this.up);this.targetQ.setFromRotationMatrix(this.lookMatrix).normalize();
 }
 apply(v,simDt){this.observation.pose(v);this.computeTarget(v);if(this.mode===0&&!this.needsReset){this.targetPosition.copy(this.chasePosition);this.target.set(v.x+Math.sin(v.yaw)*1.7,v.y+.4,v.z+Math.cos(v.yaw)*1.7);this.lookMatrix.lookAt(this.targetPosition,this.target,this.up);this.targetQ.setFromRotationMatrix(this.lookMatrix).normalize();}
 if(!Number.isFinite(this.targetPosition.x+this.targetPosition.y+this.targetPosition.z+this.targetQ.w)){this.faults++;this.targetPosition.set(Number.isFinite(v.x)?v.x:0,Number.isFinite(v.y)?v.y+1:1,Number.isFinite(v.z)?v.z:0);this.targetQ.identity();this.reason='invalid-fallback';}
 if(this.needsReset){this.camera.position.copy(this.targetPosition);this.camera.quaternion.copy(this.targetQ);this.chasePosition.copy(this.targetPosition);this.needsReset=false;}
 else if(this.blend<1){this.blend=Math.min(1,this.blend+simDt/.35);const t=this.blend*this.blend*(3-2*this.blend);this.transitionPosition.copy(this.transitionOffset).applyQuaternion(this.observation.q).add(this.observation.previousOrigin);this.camera.position.copy(this.transitionPosition).lerp(this.targetPosition,t);this.transitionWorldQ.copy(this.observation.q).multiply(this.transitionQ);this.camera.quaternion.copy(this.transitionWorldQ).slerp(this.targetQ,t);}
 else{this.camera.position.copy(this.targetPosition);this.camera.quaternion.copy(this.targetQ);}
 this.camera.up.copy(this.up);const near=this.mode===1?.025:.08;if(Math.abs(this.camera.fov-this.fov)>1e-5||this.camera.near!==near){this.camera.fov=this.fov;this.camera.near=near;this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();}
 }
 recordCPU(ms,frameMs){if(!Number.isFinite(ms+frameMs))return;this.lastCPUms=ms;this.cpuBuffer[this.metricIndex]=ms;this.frameBuffer[this.metricIndex]=frameMs;this.metricIndex=(this.metricIndex+1)%1800;this.metricCount=Math.min(1800,this.metricCount+1);}
 performanceSummary(){const n=this.metricCount;if(!n)return null;const cpu=Array.from(this.cpuBuffer.subarray(0,n)).sort((a,b)=>a-b),frames=Array.from(this.frameBuffer.subarray(0,n)).sort((a,b)=>a-b);return {samples:n,windowMaxFrames:1800,cameraCPUMsP50:cpu[Math.floor(n*.5)],cameraCPUMsP95:cpu[Math.floor(n*.95)],frameMsP50:frames[Math.floor(n*.5)],frameMsP95:frames[Math.floor(n*.95)],scope:'actual RAF and camera CPU samples; excludes GPU completion'};}
 diagnostics(){return {version:'DriverView-1.1',mode:this.mode,reason:this.reason,generation:this.observation.generation,steps:this.steps,seatAcceleration:this.observation.filteredAcceleration.toArray(),headOffset:[this.side.visual(),this.vertical.visual(),this.longitudinal.visual()],headPitchRad:clamp(this.pitch.visual()+this.longPitch.visual(),-.06,.06)*this.effect*this.safety,longitudinalPitchRad:this.longPitch.visual(),longitudinalPitchTargetRad:this.longPitchTarget??0,inertiaGain:this.inertiaGain??0,angularPitchRad:this.pitch.visual(),gazeYaw:this.gaze.x,beta:this.observation.beta,driftWeight:this.driftWeight,safety:this.safety,fov:this.fov,faults:this.faults,lastCPUms:this.lastCPUms??null,performance:this.performanceSummary(),settings:{...this.settings}};}
}
